quests.title: Betterments in Aquatic Circumstances...

dialogue.t: Fantastic... That's pretty much all of the major junk retrieved.
I'm sorry you've had to work so hard, you two.
Don't feel like you have to apologize, Freminet! The way Paimon sees it, we haven't been "working" — we've been fishing up goodies!

dialogue.sit: We helped to restore the environment.
And we found a whole bunch of treasure.

dialogue.t: Thank you... I've had such a happy and fulfilling time, and it's all thanks to you.
You're welcome! Besides, it was a team effort! Aaaand, Paimon thinks you've made some real progress. You've been a great help both underwater and on land!
Oh, uh... Alright.
I'm sorry, besides "thank you," I really don't know what else to say at times like these.
Maybe... I still need a little more practice?
Take your time, there's no hurry. Just keep working on it at your own pace!

dialogue.sit: If we get the chance, let's cooperate again in the future.
If you need any help, you can always count on us.

dialogue.t: Alright, it's a deal.
...Now that the cleanup's over, I was planning on going back underwater to spend some time alone.
But weirdly enough, after talking with you... even the sky itself seems calmer. I just wanted to... share this feeling with you.
Anyway... I'd best head back and meet up with Lyney and the others.
I'll leave the rest of the underwater survey data with you. I hope you find what you're looking for.
Hey, I could hear you celebrating from above decks. Has something good happened?
Yeah! All that junk that was upsetting the fishies has pretty much been cleared away. We also found the rest of the piano pieces!
Really? Let me take a look...
...Well, I'll be. With these components, I can finally fix the piano.
It might not be exactly how it was before, but it should be able to play beautiful music again.
Aww. You sound really happy, Sandrone!
D—Do I? Whatever, I'll go fix it right away. It shouldn't take me long. In the meantime, could I trouble you to spruce this place up a bit?
Such a wonderful instrument deserves a proper stage to set the scene.
Aww... She sure looks happy...
Whoa! What a beautiful piano!
Hmph, of course it is. It was me who fixed it, after all! I also reinforced the mechanical linkages and retouched the exterior.
You two didn't do too badly yourselves. This stage is truly worthy of this piano.
Hehe, it was nothing! Anyway, that's enough chitchat. Aren't you gonna play us a song?
...Huh? Right now?
When else? Why fix the piano if you're not gonna play?
How about... we leave the performance on hold for today! There's plenty of time for me to play for you later.
Hmph... Absolute nonsense! I—I just want to sit with it quietly for a while and reminisce about the past!
And don't think a few cheap taunts are gonna get me to play. Hmph, practice first, performance later!

quests.description: Freminet seems to have something to tell us…
